# FilmCraft (third-party notices)

Naga Films Studio’s optional editor handoff packages media for [FilmCraft](https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft).

This directory ships only FilmCraft’s `NOTICE`, `LICENSE-MIT`, and `LICENSE-APACHE` for attribution when users download a handoff zip. It does **not** include FilmCraft application source.

FilmCraft is MIT OR Apache-2.0. ArtCraft trademarks are not used in the Naga Films UI.
